subject: Meeting recap workflow for Buffer
body:
Hello Buffer Team,

I was reviewing your work on social media tools for content planning and publishing, noting that your product navigation includes "Create, Publish, Insights, Community, Collaborate, an AI Assistant and an API".

We build software that turns meeting recordings or transcripts into structured minutes, decisions and action items. We would like to explore whether a meeting recap workflow could be useful to your team.

Would you be open to a brief conversation to see if this could support your collaboration workflows?

Best regards,
UshaLabs team
UshaLabs

Thank you for considering this.
